title: Moving across with your progress
description: Cards, attachments and study results are restored as one set you can verify.

blocks.text: After a device change the list can come back without the images or the earlier study marks.

quote.text: This app was working perfectly fine and suddenly decided to delete all of my hard work by signing me out and clearing all of the cards I made. I now have lost information.

blocks.text: Show what the transfer contained and exactly what is missing. Let someone open a familiar card on both sides and check the last rating.
Getting the deck names back does not mean the material has been fully restored.
